description: parseCode: a code becomes its parts by the number of its segments: kind; kind and reason; module, entity and kind; module, entity, kind and reason. It checks neither the kind nor the spelling, and gives nothing for an empty segment or a count outside 1 to 4.

cases.name: should give the kind when the code has one segment
should give the kind and the reason when the code has two segments
should give the module, the entity and the kind when the code has three segments
should give the module, the entity, the kind and the reason when the code has four segments
should keep a two-word segment whole when the code has one
should give the kind as it is when it is not a kind of eros
should give the parts as they are when the kind is not of eros and the code has four segments
should give the segments as they are when they are not in lower kebab case
should give the whole code as the kind when it has no slash
should give a segment as it is when it holds a space
should give nothing when the code is empty
should give nothing when the code has five segments
should give nothing when the code begins with a slash
should give nothing when the code ends with a slash
should give nothing when the code has two slashes in a row
should give nothing when the code is a slash alone
